faqs.q: Why is my competitor outranking me in Austria?
faqs.a: Usually it is stronger reviews, better German-language relevance, or a more complete local presence. I audit all three and tell you which gap is actually costing you, because the fix differs in each case.

faqs.q: Do I need a Google Business Profile in Austria?
faqs.a: Yes. It is free, and for local searches Austrians check it before visiting any website. A complete profile with recent reviews will beat a nicer website with an empty profile, especially for trades and local services.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work in Austria?
faqs.a: Most businesses see early movement in 2 to 3 months and meaningful results in 4 to 6 months. Vienna is more competitive than Graz or Innsbruck, so timelines depend on where you compete.

faqs.a: It depends on your city and sector, but effective SEO is a monthly commitment. My pricing is public on this site, and the free audit shows exactly what your budget would do before you spend a cent.
